preservation_notes: No publication year is given by the current source for ref11, ref14, or ref15. These use n.d.; the 22 October 2026 access dates are retained separately.
The historical discontinued status, 20 October 2026 date, and no-longer-maintained note are preserved for ref13.
Author-preprint/manuscript/workshop URLs for ref03, ref05, ref06, and ref07 remain in notes in addition to each DOI.
The source does not specify publisher/address for conference entries or numpages for ref02. Those fields are intentionally not invented; ACM BibTeX can issue nonfatal missing-metadata warnings.
No other legacy-bibliography entries are carried over. The current manuscript has exactly 15 reference identities.
